issue.title: Static routes not available in config_db.json and does not work after upgrade

failure.body:
#### Static routes not available in config_db.json and does not work after upgrade

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Add RIF: sudo config interface ip add Ethernet0 <IP>/24
2. Add static route via RIF: sudo config route add prefix <IP>/32 nexthop <IP>
3. Check that static route exist: "show ip route"
4. Save config: "sudo config save -y"
5. Check that static route exist in /etc/sonic/config_db.json
6. Do upgrade to new image
7. Check that static route exist: "show ip route"

#### Describe the results you received:
In step 3 - we can see that static route exist:
```Codes: K - kernel route, C - connected, S - static, R - RIP,
       O - OSPF, I - IS-IS, B - BGP, E - EIGRP, N - NHRP,
       T - Table, v - VNC, V - VNC-Direct, A - Babel, D - SHARP,
       F - PBR, f - OpenFabric,
       > - selected route, * - FIB route, q - queued, r - rejected, b - backup

K>* <IP>/0 [0/0] via X.X.X.X, eth0, <IPV6>
S>* <IP>/32 [1/0] via <IP>, Ethernet0, weight 1, <IPV6>
C>* X.X.X.X/X is directly connected, eth0, <IPV6>
C>* <IP>/24 is directly connected, Ethernet0, <IPV6>
```
in step 5 - we are unable to see static route in config_db.json
In step 7 - after upgrade - static route does not exist.

#### Describe the results you expected:
Static route after cmd "config save -y" available in config_db.json
Static route exist after upgrade to new SONiC version.
